definitions.gloss: errand; doing business; running an errand
definitions.explanation: going out to take care of some task or business

definitions.gloss: going to the bathroom; using the toilet
definitions.explanation: a euphemistic expression for using the restroom

examples.japanese: {用足|ようた}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: To go out on an errand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{用足|ようた}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To take care of business at the bank.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{用足|ようた}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ってきます→行ってきます：01029_ittekimasu⟧。
examples.english: I'll be back in a moment; I need to take care of something.

examples.japanese: {用足|ようた}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I need to use the bathroom.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{用足|ようた}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧したがって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The child needs to go to the bathroom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{用足|ようた}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't use the toilet outside (of home).

notes:
USAGE:
- {用足|ようた}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go on an errand; to go to the bathroom)
- {用足|ようた}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to run an errand; to use the toilet)
- {用足|ようた}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧ (to go out for errands)

SENSE 2 (Euphemism):
A polite, indirect way to say one needs to use the bathroom. Common with children or in formal situations.

OTHER BATHROOM EUPHEMISMS:
- ⟦お{手洗|てあら}い→お手洗い：02861_otearai⟧ (bathroom - lit. hand-washing)
- ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to the toilet - direct)
- {御不浄|ごふじょう} (lavatory - very formal)

- ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧ (shopping)
